area_note: Bangkok, centred on Benjakitti and Lumpini parks, plus hash runs held around the wider city
intro: Most Bangkok group runs start from two parks: Benjakitti Park in Khlong Toei (MRT Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre) and Lumpini Park (BTS Sala Daeng / MRT Silom). An elevated walkway joins the two parks into a traffic-free loop of about 10 km. Because temperatures sit between 30 and 37°C for much of the year, most sessions start before 7am or after sunset, and Lumpini evening runs set off after the 6pm national anthem. Some groups call off runs when PM2.5 readings are high or when it rains. Several Hash House Harrier chapters also run on different days of the week at changing sites around the city.

clubs.name: Sabai Run Club Bangkok

meets.where: Benjakitti Park (meeting point posted weekly on Instagram)

clubs.who: All levels; Thai locals, expats and visitors
clubs.description: A social run club whose motto is 'we run a little and socialise a lot'. Runs are short, sometimes 18 to 30 minutes. Time Out Bangkok reported around 400 runners on Sunday mornings and over 1,000 on Friday nights. The club posts each week's meeting point on Instagram (@sabairunclub.bkk).
clubs.active_evidence: Time Out Bangkok feature, 23 Feb 2026; Maitria Hotels guide, 6 Aug 2026

clubs.name: Bangkok Runners

meets.where: Benjakitti Park running track, north end near the car park entrance

clubs.who: Mixed abilities and nationalities; newcomers asked to try 2–3 runs before signing up
clubs.description: A Meetup group that has run together since June 2012. The weekly 'Easy Peasy' run covers 5–7 km at 6.5–8 min/km and sometimes crosses the GreenMile walkway to Lumpini Park. The run is postponed in heavy rain, run as a walk when PM2.5 is 100–120, and cancelled when PM2.5 is above 120.
clubs.active_evidence: Meetup events titled '2026 Easy Peasy Benjakitti / Lumpini Park Run', scheduled weekly through Oct 2026

clubs.name: Lumpini Running Club Bangkok

meets.when: Tuesdays and Thursdays, meet 5:45pm, run from about 6pm
meets.where: Lumpini Park, Gate 4 by the King Rama VI statue, at the corner by the small water shop

clubs.description: Evening runs in Lumpini Park where most people do 2–3 laps at their own pace. The group sometimes has dinner together afterwards. Runs are cancelled if it rains. Free lockers (bring your own padlock) and showers are in the nearby restroom.
clubs.active_evidence: Meetup events scheduled for 1, 6 and 8 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Ugly Running Training Club (URT)

meets.where: Benjakitti Park, Gate 3, by the stretching zone

clubs.who: All levels; no pace or PB questions
clubs.description: A punk-styled crew that has no coach, no membership and no sign-up. Time Out Bangkok described it as more about style and fun than lap times. The crew announces occasional events on Instagram.

clubs.name: SarDine Run Club

meets.where: Rotates between Suan Rot Fai (Chatuchak), Lumpini Park and Benjakitti Park

clubs.who: Beginners to experienced runners; no sign-up
clubs.description: A Bangkok-born crew whose Saturday runs move between parks, plus pop-up city events that are sometimes run with venues and other clubs. The club also has a Facebook page (facebook.com/sardinerun.th).
clubs.active_evidence: Time Out Bangkok feature, 23 Feb 2026; Maitria Hotels guide, 6 Aug 2026

clubs.name: Cruise Control Run Club

meets.when: Weekly social run (day and time posted on Instagram)

clubs.who: First-time runners to marathoners and ultra runners
clubs.description: A run club built around streetwear and sneaker culture that runs social, city and long runs. The founders say they are not coaches or experts. The club also has a Strava club (strava.com/clubs/cruisecontrolrunclub).
clubs.active_evidence: Time Out Bangkok feature, 23 Feb 2026; Maitria Hotels guide, 6 Aug 2026

clubs.name: Meep Meep Run Club (MMRC)
clubs.cost: Free for most runs; some special city routes need pre-booking
clubs.description: An inclusive crew that runs morning sessions with theCOMMONS, starting with a short briefing, then coffee and socialising. It has also held Pride Month runs. Time Out suggests arriving 15 minutes early for the briefing.

clubs.name: Brew Run Club
clubs.cost: Regular park runs free; some themed and brand events ticketed (e.g. via Ticketmelon)
clubs.description: The running club of Brew Yoga Thailand, with the motto 'Sip, Stride and Socialise'. Runs are followed by coffee, tea, cocktails or smoothies at partner venues. Its themed events have included vertical building runs.
clubs.active_evidence: Time Out Bangkok feature, 23 Feb 2026; Maitria Hotels guide, 6 Aug 2026

clubs.name: CNX-BKK Brotherhood
clubs.who: Open to all; started by Chiang Mai natives living in Bangkok
clubs.description: A self-described 'Daydrinker & Runner Club' that has run 5K, 10K and 15K challenges with theCOMMONS. To find the next run, message the club on Instagram.
clubs.active_evidence: Time Out Bangkok feature, 23 Feb 2026; Maitria Hotels guide, 6 Aug 2026

clubs.name: Run Now Fab Later Crew (RNFL)
clubs.description: A style-led crew that holds regular runs, trail camps and brand collaborations, and turns up as a group at events such as the Amazing Thailand Marathon. The crew posts run announcements on Instagram.

clubs.name: Mikkeller Running Club Bangkok
clubs.cost: Free to run; buying the official MRC shirt gives global membership
clubs.description: The Bangkok chapter of the Copenhagen brewery's worldwide running club. The monthly 5.6 km neighbourhood loop ends with a complimentary house beer. No sign-up is needed, and the shirt also gives 10% off at Mikkeller venues.

clubs.name: HOKA Run Club Thailand
clubs.who: Registered runners (sign-up via the official form)
clubs.description: The HOKA Thailand brand club, which runs weekly Wednesday training, monthly social activities and shoe try-ons. It held a coach-led training programme at Thephasadin Stadium on 21 February 2026 for runners who had registered.
clubs.active_evidence: HOKA Thailand post on a training programme, 21 Feb 2026

clubs.name: Bangkok Hash House Harriers (BH3)

meets.where: Changing sites in and around Bangkok (Google Maps link posted per run)

clubs.who: Men only, except announced open outstation runs
clubs.description: Bangkok's gentlemen's hash, which has run every Saturday since 1977. A hare lays a trail and the group follows it, then socialises afterwards. An open outstation weekend in Buriram, open to everyone, is set for 27–29 November 2026.
clubs.active_evidence: Website lists run 2531 on 3 Oct and 2532 on 10 Oct 2026, and a 2026/27 hareline

clubs.name: Bangkok Monday Hash House Harriers (BMH3)

meets.where: Changing sites around Bangkok (published on the hareline)

clubs.who: Everyone welcome: Thai, foreign, residents and visitors
clubs.description: A mixed hash that runs every Monday evening, then drinks and socialises. It has a visitors' page with advice on taxis. The club says to bring a torch now that evenings get dark earlier.
clubs.active_evidence: Hareline lists run 2232 on 5 Oct 2026; page last updated 29 Sep 2026

clubs.name: Bangkok Hash House Harriettes

meets.where: Changing sites around Bangkok (published on the hareline)

clubs.description: A Wednesday-evening hash founded in 1982. Shared taxis are sometimes arranged from MRT stations.
clubs.active_evidence: Run 2283 on 30 Sep 2026; hareline to Nov 2026

clubs.name: Bangkok Thursday Hash

meets.where: Changing sites, usually near a BTS station (directions posted per run)

clubs.description: An evening hash that posts station-based directions for each run. Runners are asked to bring a torch.
clubs.active_evidence: Run #537 on 1 Oct 2026 from BTS Phra Khanong

clubs.name: Bangkok Full Moon Hash

meets.when: Once a month on a Friday evening, 6:30pm

clubs.description: A monthly Friday-night hash, now in its 23rd year. Runners are asked to bring a torch.

clubs.name: Siam Sunday Hash House Harriers

meets.where: Changing sites (Google Maps link posted per run)

clubs.description: A fortnightly Sunday-afternoon hash with a 2026 committee and posted run directions.

clubs.name: Bangkok Sabai Saturday Hash (BSSH3)

meets.when: Selected Saturdays, meet 13:45, run starts 15:00 (dates on the website)
meets.where: Bus from CHARM Bistro, On Nut BTS area, to a countryside trail outside Bangkok

clubs.cost: Paid per run: run/walk fee plus optional return bus, booked on the website
clubs.who: All fitness levels; run, jog or walk; family-friendly, children welcome with parents
clubs.description: A non-profit social running and walking hash that takes a bus from central Bangkok to countryside trails, typically 5-7 km and 60-90 minutes, followed by refreshments at the run site.
clubs.active_evidence: Website lists upcoming runs on 10 Oct and 31 Oct 2026 and a notice about the cancelled 26 Sep 2026 run

coaches.name: ironguides Bangkok (The Method Triathlon Club)
coaches.offers: Drop-in coached running class on Wednesdays at 6:30pm (400 THB); 30-day (1,000 THB) and 90-day (2,000 THB) run-session packages; group training plans; personalised coaching from 6,900 THB a month
coaches.credentials: Head coach Vinnie Santana holds an ITU (World Triathlon) Level 1 coaching certification
coaches.description: The Bangkok squad of the ironguides coaching company, offering coached sessions for runners, triathletes and swimmers of all abilities, from drop-ins up to custom plans with coach feedback.
coaches.active_evidence: Live booking page with session prices; site footer © 2026 (no dated 2026 post found)
